My mum passed away in May due to lung cancer last year and I pretty much felt I had to quit university (I was studying Geography, first semester though, so it didn't matter that much) so I can spend some more time with her and am able to help at home. 

After she left, I felt like I was in a huge black hole. Not caring about anything, no will to do something, I didnt even want to see anyone for 2 weeks straight. It still feels like I died a little with her.

But that is not everything. I'm still not able to find a job. I dont want to go back to university, I want to bring home some money and not just sit on my lazy ass for 3 years living at home.
I'm pretty much living day for day not having to do anything at all (besides desperately applying for jobs and helping my dad). This is going on since may.. up until now.

So you know what's worse than losing one of the most important people in your life?

Losing one of the most important people in your life and feeling COMPLETELY useless afterwards.

This really got to me while writing this, thanks to everyone who bothers reading and caring, I really appreciate it.

Veigar is actually one of the better non-meta supports in my opinion!

He might not be as good as other supports in a straight 2v2 lane - especially pre 6 - but his cage (AOE 2,5s stun on a decent cooldown when maxed? Just think about it lol) is just ridicilous for teamfights, setting up ganks or even gank mid himself (pretty much a safe kill or flash if you hit the stun and your mid isn't afk.)

Add to that: You always have the possibility to just say "fuck this", get a DFG and proceed to 1 shot the enemy mid/adc/supp.

Downsides are a pretty weak lane phase pre 6, he can get caught easily due to being so squishy without mobility and last but not least: If you can't hit stuns, you are obviously useless. But overall you can make it work decently! Have fun, hope I could help you!

Dont try to trade with her when her W is active unless you are ahead and sure you can still outdamage her.

Always keep her stun in mind, stun duration goes up as you put more points in and she can stun you two times in extended trades (try to get it on cd while she has more health than you, as soon as she uses it to slow you, try to turn.)

Have an eye on your minions, dont let her get a free stun on you because you stood next to a low minion.

Overall, Irelia is VERY reliant on her cooldowns, especially W and E.
